desc: Precompute prefix sums of the form $S_{j}[x] = \sum_{i=1}^x i \cdot P_{i-1}^j$ and $T_{j}[x] = \sum_{i=1}^x i \cdot P_{i}^j$ for each $j \in [0, K]$.
Implement a function to compute the 4 components of the inclusion-exclusion sum for $T_2$ efficiently using the precomputed arrays and binomial expansion.
Calculate final answer: $((N+1) \cdot T_1 - T_2) \pmod M$.
Run the code against Sample 1, Sample 2, and Sample 3 to verify correctness.
If samples pass, the solution is complete.
